name: translate-hover
description: Select text in any file and get a Google Translate popup right in the editor.

commands.title: Translate: Set Google Cloud API Key
Translate: Clear Google Cloud API Key

translateHover.targetLanguage.description: Target language code (e.g. vi, en, ja, zh-CN).

translateHover.sourceLanguage.description: Source language code, or 'auto' to detect.

translateHover.quickLanguages.description: Language codes shown as one-click shortcuts inside the popup. Set to [] to hide the row.

translateHover.showIconOnSelect.description: Show a small translate icon right after the selected text.

translateHover.manualSelectionOnly.description: Only show the 🌐 marker for selections made with the mouse or the keyboard. Selections a command produced — stepping through Find matches, Select All, Expand Selection — leave no marker. The Translate Selection command and its keybinding still work on any selection.

translateHover.confirmBeforeTranslate.description: Require a click on the 🌐 marker before a selection is sent to the translation engine. Hovering the selection alone never triggers a request. Turn this off to translate on hover, as earlier versions did.

translateHover.autoShowPopup.description: Automatically open the translation popup as soon as text is selected (no hover needed).

translateHover.autoShowDelay.description: Delay in ms before reacting to a selection change.

translateHover.hoverOnWord.description: Also translate the word under the cursor when nothing is selected.

translateHover.maxLength.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters sent to the translation engine. The free endpoint carries the text in the URL and rejects anything past roughly 16 KB, which a CJK character reaches after about 1,800 characters — raise this only with `#translateHover.apiKey#` set.

enumDescriptions: Keep every line break: each line is translated and shown on its own line.
Only keep blank lines between paragraphs; hard-wrapped lines are folded into one sentence.
Flatten the whole selection onto a single line.
translateHover.preserveLineBreaks.description: How line breaks in the selected text are handled.

translateHover.renderMarkdown.markdownDescription: Render Markdown tables in the popup as tables. Only blocks that Markdown would accept as a table — consecutive `|` rows carrying a `| --- |` divider — are treated this way; every other line keeps its own line break as before.

translateHover.stripCommentMarkers.description: Strip //, /*, *, # and leading indentation from the selected text before translating.

translateHover.showStatusBar.description: Show the current language pair in the status bar.

translateHover.apiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Superseded by the **Translate: Set Google Cloud API Key** command, which keeps the key in the OS keychain instead of settings.json. A value left here is moved into the keychain on the next start and then removed.
translateHover.apiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated — run **Translate: Set Google Cloud API Key** instead. With no key the free, unofficial endpoints are used (`clients5.google.com`, falling back to `translate.googleapis.com`); with one, the official Cloud Translation API v2 handles every request and the free endpoints are never called.

translateHover.proxy.description: Optional host to use instead of clients5.google.com (e.g. a mirror).
